edges: Air Commodore Adrian 'King' Cole was the inaugural Air Officer Commanding of Central Area Command.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: Air Commodore Bill Anderson took over command of Central Area Command from Adrian 'King' Cole.
A proposal was made to carve a new Central Area Command out of Eastern Area.
No. 2 Group was re-formed as Central Area Command.
Central Area Command was formed by the Royal Australian Air Force during World War II.
No. 2 (Training) Group was formed to take responsibility for training units under Central Area Command.
